title: Queued-send burst offline performance characterization
purpose: Authorize one exact queued_send_burst_budget performance characterization slice whose only permitted values are legacy_current and single_datagram, while preserving the existing correctness/onboarding trace family, keeping all adjacent axes legacy_current, and leaving performance acceptance, rule derivation, active behavior, and production activation false.
scope: This specification applies only to the two configured queued_send_burst_budget cells formed by legacy_current and single_datagram while receive_credit_allocation, application_send_turn_planning, application_send_batch_formation, oversized_write_admission_quantum, and buffer_copy_coalescing remain legacy_current. It governs one manifest-bound offline measurement authority, a deterministic eight-block two-position campaign, package-backed ProtocolLab execution, bounded aggregate evidence, resumability, and a descriptive non-accepting result. It does not authorize covering-array generation, wider Stage 1 execution, active behavior, performance acceptance, adaptive-rule derivation, or production activation.
context: queued_send_burst_budget already has a correctness/onboarding contract, a published actuation plan, and an activation predicate that distinguishes the legal single_datagram case from the legacy_current case. This slice adds timing-only characterization for the exact two-cell family after the queued-send gate is proven, using the existing ProtocolLab raw QUIC boundary and keeping the measurement result descriptive rather than promotional.

requirements.title: Authorize the exact queued-send performance family
requirements.statement: The repository MUST restrict queued_send_burst_budget performance characterization to exactly the legacy_current and single_datagram values while every adjacent adaptive-runtime axis, including receive_credit_allocation, application_send_turn_planning, application_send_batch_formation, oversized_write_admission_quantum, and buffer_copy_coalescing, remains legacy_current; keep performance acceptance authorization false, active behavior authorization false, and production activation false; and reject every outside queued-send configuration.

requirements.title: Bind one manifest-backed offline measurement authority
requirements.statement: The repository MUST authorize queued-send performance measurement only through one exact manifest-bound offline authority whose runtime token binds a stable authorization identity, manifest hash, and the two configured queued-send cells, while package and job evidence bind the exact source commit and binary hash; require every adjacent axis to stay legacy_current; reject a stale binding, outside cell, non-manifest execution, or any claim of performance acceptance; and keep the authority additive and reviewable.

requirements.title: Compile the deterministic two-position campaign before timing
requirements.statement: The repository MUST compile a deterministic eight-block two-position campaign for the exact legacy_current and single_datagram queued-send cells before any timing run; preserve block identity, position identity, treatment order, cell identity, and repetition identity; produce exactly 16 jobs and 8 repetitions per cell; and reject covering-array generation or any extra cell.

requirements.title: Execute package-backed ProtocolLab jobs with resumable bounded evidence
requirements.statement: The repository MUST execute the queued-send performance campaign through package-backed ProtocolLab using exact cell identity, job identity, run identity, package identity, controller identity, host identity, workload identity, and bounded aggregate evidence; retain failed, retried, and resumed attempts instead of deleting them; and materialize a canonical descriptive result that remains bounded and replayable.

requirements.title: Require the stream-throughput gate before accepting timing rows
requirements.statement: The repository MUST use quic.transport.stream-throughput.1mb as the activation gate workload for the single_datagram treatment and prove predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one before accepting any timing row for that treatment; if the predicate is not proven, the row remains evidence but not accepted.

requirements.title: Analyze the result without releasing behavior
requirements.statement: Offline analysis MUST preserve the two configured queued-send cells and their block and position identities, report a canonical descriptive result from bounded aggregate evidence, and not derive an adaptive rule, select a winner, activate active behavior, or authorize production activation; covering-array generation remains unnecessary.
